brief: A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.

requirements.requirement: Hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers
requirements.evidence: 3x hex-acc-keyhole on rear face slot 1 (accessory:0#-1,0#1, accessory:0#0,0#1, accessory:0#1,0#1) - lift-and-drop mount

7 hook plates installed (7 accessories with hex-acc-hook across level 0 and 1). Configurator restricts hangable props to cable coil / gaffer tape / FPV goggles; demonstrated with 2 cable coils on upper hooks. Steel tools like pliers/screwdrivers cannot be hung per addProp validation - shape is correct for small hand tools if used with string/lanyard.

finish.summary: 3-cell wide rack (2 storeys high for clearance) with 3 rear keyhole hangers and 7 hook plates across front faces. House rules joint-locked. Demonstrated with cable coils; hook geometry supports small hand tools via lanyard although prop library limits direct hanging to coils/tape.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
